info.title: Realtime Trains Rail Service Action
info.description: Read live and scheduled UK rail services, allocations and Know Your Train coach data from the Realtime Trains API. Data can be absent or change.

get.description: Returns times, destination, platform, allocation and live status.

parameters.name: station
parameters.description: UK station name or CRS code, such as Bristol Temple Meads or BRI.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Number of departures to return.

parameters.name: minutes
parameters.description: How far ahead to search in minutes.

401.description: Missing or incorrect action API key

get.summary: Search arrivals or departures at a station
get.description: Find a particular working or candidates for a forming service. Returns uniqueIdentity values that can be passed to getServiceDetails.

parameters.name: station
parameters.description: UK station name or CRS code, such as Bristol Temple Meads or BRI.

parameters.name: time_from
parameters.description: ISO-8601 start datetime. Omit to start now.

parameters.name: time_to
parameters.description: ISO-8601 end datetime. Do not combine with minutes.

parameters.name: minutes
parameters.description: Window length when time_to is omitted.

parameters.name: filter_from
parameters.description: Only services previously calling at this station name or CRS code.

parameters.name: filter_to
parameters.description: Only services subsequently calling at this station name or CRS code.

parameters.name: movement
parameters.description: Whether to return arrivals, departures or both.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Maximum services to return.

401.description: Missing or incorrect action API key

get.summary: Get TIGER coach evidence for an exact RTT UID at a station
get.description: Get coach facilities for an exact RTT UID at a TIPLOC. Supply unique_identity to resolve a CRS and reconcile with RTT; pass departure_date to verify the date. RTT remains authoritative for operational data. Missing facilities and unknown orientation must not be inferred.

parameters.name: tiploc
parameters.description: Explicit TIGER TIPLOC, for example PADTON for RTT CRS PAD. Never send CRS as TIPLOC.

parameters.name: departure_date
parameters.description: RTT service departure date; never inferred from the current date.

parameters.name: unique_identity
parameters.description: Exact opaque uniqueIdentity returned by RTT, for reconciliation.

401.description: Missing or incorrect action API key

404.description: TIGER location not found, or no exact UID/date match

409.description: Multiple matching TIGER services; no selection made

200.description: TIGER evidence, optionally reconciled with RTT

iconUrl.description: Small public SVG carriage icon. Render as a Markdown image beside the coach letter; position is schematic, not a vehicle model.

parameters.name: unique_identity

trackingSince.description: UTC time from which the counters are available.

lastRequestAt.description: UTC time of the most recently counted request.

401.description: Missing or incorrect action API key

get.summary: Suggest a topology-backed railway route and map
get.description: Uses the Movebook railway routing engine to resolve an origin and destination, calculate railway mileage and geometry, and return a map link plus valid alternative via points. This is an infrastructure route, not a timetable, ticket or guaranteed passenger itinerary.

parameters.name: include_snapshot
parameters.description: Set true only when the user requests a static map image. Returns mapImageUrl for Markdown embedding, fitted to the entire route.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: Origin station name or CRS code.

parameters.name: destination
parameters.description: Destination station name or CRS code.

parameters.name: via
parameters.description: Optional comma-separated TIPLOC codes selected from candidates returned by an earlier route call, in travel order.

401.description: Missing or incorrect action API key

get.summary: Map a dated itinerary from verified RTT services
get.description: Use for maps of actual trains or connecting journeys. Fetches each exact RTT service and follows its calls and passing points in order. Returns mapUrl, leg evidence and warnings. Geometry between schedule points is inferred; minimum connection times are not verified.

parameters.name: legs
parameters.description: JSON array of 1-6 ordered legs, each with unique_identity (exact RTT uniqueIdentity), origin and destination (station name or CRS). Example: [{"unique_identity":"gb-nr:G01162:2026-09-19","origin":"NCL","destination":"PLY"}]. Never invent identities.

parameters.name: include_snapshot
parameters.description: Default false. True only for an explicit request for a static snapshot or embedded image; a route map request alone means an interactive link.

401.description: Missing or incorrect action API key

get.summary: Create a static image of an existing route map
get.description: On user request, render a saved route as a whole-route PNG. Use the id from the returned mapUrl. Embed returned mapImageUrl as a Markdown image and keep mapUrl as an interactive link.

parameters.name: map_id
parameters.description: The 24-character id at the end of a returned mapUrl.

401.description: Missing or incorrect action API key
